verses.1: For I am an Israelite, and I love him. From Egypt, I called out to my son.
verses.2: They were called upon to go from their place to their masters, to be sacrificed, and to be destroyed.
verses.3: And I will learn from Ephraim how to treat their wounds properly. They won’t know that I’m actually a healer.
verses.4: In the bonds of human love, they will be united by those bonds. They will become like ascending mountains above their lives, and he will serve them.
verses.5: He shall not return to Egypt. Assyria will be his king, for from us he will not return.
verses.6: And Herve was sick in his towns, and he died from his wounds. He ate what they gave him to eat.
verses.7: And my people will stand up when I return, and they will call out to him together, without being afraid.
verses.8: How we have afflicted you, O Israel! How we have treated you as if you were just a piece of land. We have turned you into beasts. But now, I will take care of you. Together, we will be reconciled.
verses.9: I will not make any idols. I will not return to worship idols again. For I am God, and no one else is worthy of worshiping. And I will not enter the city at all.
verses.10: After Jehovah, they will go forth like eagles. They will soar high up into the sky, and the children of the valley will be terrified.
verses.11: They will be scattered like moths from Egypt, and like locusts from the land of Assyria. And they will be placed upon their own houses, says the Lord.
